style.sofa: a sculptural cream bouclé sofa with rounded organic shapes and a few dark burgundy and teal cushions
style.room: A sophisticated mid-century modern living room with a warm contemporary interpretation: a walnut sideboard with clean mid-century lines, a pair of vintage-inspired lounge chairs with wooden frames, a low sculptural solid wood coffee table beside the sofa, a mushroom table lamp, ceramic vases, a large indoor olive tree, one understated abstract artwork with organic geometric shapes. Colour palette: warm ivory, natural walnut, cream, muted blush pink, deep burgundy, forest green and restrained teal accents. Lighting: warm directional afternoon sunlight, natural shadows, intimate yet bright. Premium interior editorial photography, organic furniture silhouettes, authentic wood grain, tactile materials, 35mm lens, photorealistic, high detail.
